subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with long dark hair partially tied up with a green patterned ribbon, a small dark drop earring, and a pale celadon-and-white hanfu robe embroidered with red blossoms and green leaves.
<Subject 2> is the small ceramic wine jar in <Picture 2>, sealed with a dark red cloth cover tied by a red cord, bearing a red diamond paper label reading "女儿红".
<Subject 3> is the water sword in <Picture 3>, whose blade is a flowing stream of splashing clear liquid, whose hilt is a green wrapped handle grown from the jar's base, decorated with the jar's red cloth and red cord bound around the hilt, and whose structure incorporates the suspended broken pottery shards of the jar.

summary:
[reference generation] The 15-second target video follows <Subject 1>, who storms drunk and grief-stricken into an inn room, drinks from <Subject 2>, then hurls the jar at a wooden pillar; the shattering jar transforms in bullet time into <Subject 3>, which flies back to her, and after she catches it and cuts her own throat, the video ends on her blurred first-person view spinning into blackout.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the woman's facial features, hairstyle with green ribbon, earring, and embroidered hanfu from <Picture 1> are retained.
<Picture 1> (style anchor for all shots): weak_reference - its realistic live-action photographic texture, soft natural lighting, and slightly desaturated palette are maintained across the entire video.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): partially_preserved - the jar's ceramic body, red cloth seal, red cord, and "女儿红" label are retained intact until [Shot 3], where the shattering jar transfers its shards, cloth, and cord into <Subject 3>.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - the fluid water blade, green hilt, red cloth and cord decorations, and suspended pottery-shard structure match <Picture 3>.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a live-action cinematic style that maintains the realistic photographic texture, soft natural lighting, and slightly desaturated color palette of <Picture 1> throughout.
[Shot 1] A medium tracking shot opens on <Subject 1>, the young woman in the embroidered pale-celadon hanfu, her brows tightly knitted and her eyes wet with tears as if she has just been weeping. The camera tracks her at fast speed as she staggers around a corridor corner of the ancient Chinese inn, then she wheels around and forcefully shoves open a wooden lattice door, bursting into the room and collapsing onto the wooden table. With her left hand she angrily sweeps several small dishes off the tabletop onto the floor. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as she seizes a pair of chopsticks and stabs them through the red cloth seal of <Subject 2>, the wine jar labeled "女儿红"; at that instant a single tear falls from her cheek through the torn hole in the cloth into the jar. She lifts the jar, throws her head back, and drinks in wild gulps while tears stream down her face.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> gulping the wine, liquid spilling along her chin. Drunk and unsteady, she lowers <Subject 2> toward the table, but as the jar's bottom nears the tabletop she hesitates, her hand trembling; she then twists her body and hurls the jar violently at the wooden pillar beside her.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a bullet-time slow-motion view as <Subject 2> strikes the pillar and bursts open. The camera holds a static shot while the remaining wine stretches and grows into a long fluid blade of splashing clear liquid, the jar's base grows into a green wrapped sword hilt, the red cloth and red cord wind themselves tightly around the hilt as decorations, and the shattered pottery shards settle into a stable suspended structure, so the assembled weapon comes to match exactly the overall form of <Subject 3> in <Picture 3>.
[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts back to <Subject 1> as <Subject 3> flies toward her. Still drunk, she raises her right hand without conscious intent, turns sideways, and catches the hilt. She looks at the water sword and suddenly regains her senses; her brows knit tightly and her breath catches in a choked, sobbing sniffle.
[Shot 5] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up as she turns and draws the fluid blade of <Subject 3> across her own neck, the water stream grazing her skin. She collapses to the floor, dead. The view then switches to her dying, blurred first-person POV as the room spins dizzily, the vision darkens at the edges, and the screen cuts to black.

overall_soundscape:
Hurried staggering footsteps and ragged breathing accompany the run, followed by the creak and slam of the wooden door, the crash of dishes on the floor, the tear of cloth, and glugging wine. The jar shatters against the pillar with a sharp ceramic crash, and her body falls to the floor with a dull thud before silence.
